This '''four-armed alien race''' were blue-skinned humanoids with large heads and their V-shaped mouths gave them the appearance of a perpetual smile. Their homeworld's gravity was much less than standard, so they were confined to anti-grav chairs. [[Ellam]] was a member of this species.<ref name="GC" />
